task.title: Install AEM Guides on an On-Premise AEM Server
task.shortdesc: Install and validate AEM Guides on an on-premise Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) author/publish deployment.

step.cmd: {'step': 'Verify prerequisites and compatibility', 'substeps': ['Confirm the target AEM version and service pack are supported by your AEM Guides release.', 'Ensure you have AEM administrator access and OS-level access to the AEM host(s).', 'Back up the AEM repository and configuration (crx-quickstart, dispatcher configs, and any custom OSGi configs).']}

{'step': 'Prepare the AEM environment', 'substeps': ['Stop the AEM Author and Publish instances.', 'Clear any pending package installs and confirm sufficient disk space for package deployment and indexing.', 'If using Dispatcher, plan a maintenance window to clear cache after installation.']}

{'step': 'Install AEM Guides packages on Author', 'substeps': ['Start the AEM Author instance.', 'Open Package Manager at /crx/packmgr.', 'Upload the AEM Guides installation package(s) provided by Adobe.', 'Install packages in the vendor-recommended order (foundation/dependencies first, then AEM Guides core, then any add-ons).', 'Verify each package shows a successful install status with no errors in error.log.']}

{'step': 'Install AEM Guides packages on Publish (if applicable)', 'substeps': ['Start the AEM Publish instance.', 'Open Package Manager at /crx/packmgr.', 'Upload and install the same AEM Guides packages required for Publish, following the same order.', 'Confirm publish-side bundles are active and logs show no unresolved dependencies.']}

{'step': 'Apply required OSGi configurations', 'substeps': ['In Author, open /system/console/configMgr and locate AEM Guides-related configurations.', 'Set repository paths, service users/permissions, and any integration endpoints required by your deployment.', 'If you manage configs as code, place .cfg.json files under the correct runmode folders and redeploy.']}

{'step': 'Validate bundles, services, and permissions', 'substeps': ['Open /system/console/bundles and confirm all AEM Guides bundles are Active.', 'Check /system/console/status-productinfo (or equivalent) to confirm installed package versions.', 'Verify required service users exist and have permissions on content, dam, and configuration paths used by AEM Guides.']}

{'step': 'Run post-install indexing and cache maintenance', 'substeps': ['Trigger or allow any required Oak index updates to complete; monitor error.log for indexing issues.', 'If using Dispatcher, clear relevant caches and invalidate as needed after installation.']}

{'step': 'Perform functional smoke tests', 'substeps': ['Log in to AEM Author and confirm AEM Guides UI components load without errors.', 'Create or open a DITA map/topic in the configured repository location and verify basic authoring actions work.', 'If Publish is installed, publish a small DITA map and verify output is generated and accessible.']}

{'step': 'Document the installation state', 'substeps': ['Record installed package names/versions, AEM runmodes, and applied OSGi configuration changes.', 'Capture relevant log excerpts if any warnings were observed during installation for future troubleshooting.']}

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
